This fixture contains synthetic, inert unit-test data only.
`usr/lib/apache2/modules/libphp.so` is not a real PHP module and is not executable.
dpkg status/md5sums entries are fabricated to exercise the apache module
provenance reverse-lookup against an unversioned module filename.

The proc namespace and root entries contain inert symlink target strings. The
unit test materializes them as proc-like symlinks in its temporary fixture copy.
